using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.MediaEncoding;
using MediaBrowser.MediaEncoding.Encoder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class EncoderValidatorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<EncoderValidator>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly ILogger<EncoderValidator> _logger;
    private readonly EncoderValidator _validator;

    public EncoderValidatorTests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<EncoderValidator>>();
        _logger = _loggerMock.Object;
        _validator = new EncoderValidator(_logger, "/path/to/ffmpeg");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullFilter_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption(null, "someOption");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>>((v, t) => VerifyLogWarning(v, t, null, "someOption")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyFilter_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("", "someOption");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>>((v, t) => VerifyLogWarning(v, t, "", "someOption")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullOption_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("someFilter", null);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>>((v, t) => VerifyLogWarning(v, t, "someFilter", null)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyOption_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("someFilter", "");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>>((v, t) => VerifyLogWarning(v, t, "someFilter", "")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CheckFilterWithOption_ValidFilterNoOptionMatch_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Arrange - This would require mocking GetProcessOutput, but for LogWarning coverage
        // we test the path that reaches line 511 (after Contains checks fail)

        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("testfilter", "testoption");

        // Assert - In real scenario this depends on ffmpeg output, but LogWarning path exists
        // We verify the logging mechanism works for the specific call signature
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>>((v, t) => VerifyLogWarning(v, t, "testfilter", "testoption")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    private static bool VerifyLogWarning(It.IsAnyFormat<LogWarningInfo> state, string format, string expectedFilter, string expectedOption)
    {
        return format == "Filter: {Name} with option {Option} is not available"
            && state.ToString().Contains($"Name: {expectedFilter}")
            && state.ToString().Contains($"Option: {expectedOption}");
    }

    // Additional test for the similar BitStreamFilter LogWarning call
    [Fact]
    public void CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption_NullFilter_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
    {
        // Act
        var result = _validator.CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption(null, "someOption");

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<LogBitstreamWarningInfo>>((v, t) => VerifyBitstreamLogWarning(v, t, null, "someOption")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<LogBitstreamWarningInfo>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private static bool VerifyBitstreamLogWarning(It.IsAnyFormat<LogBitstreamWarningInfo> state, string format, string expectedFilter, string expectedOption)
    {
        return format == "Bit stream filter: {Name} with option {Option} is not available"
            && state.ToString().Contains($"Name: {expectedFilter}")
            && state.ToString().Contains($"Option: {expectedOption}");
    }
}

public class LogWarningInfo
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Option { get; set; }
}

public class LogBitstreamWarningInfo
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Option { get; set; }
}

        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyFilter_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Act
            bool result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("", "option");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_NullOption_ReturnsFalse()
        {

            // Assert

        public void CheckFilterWithOption_EmptyOption_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Act
            bool result = _validator.CheckFilterWithOption("filter", "");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CheckFilterWithOption_ValidInputsNoFilterMatch_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange

        public void CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption_NullFilter_ReturnsFalse()

            // Assert

        }

        public void CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption_ValidInputsNoFilterMatch_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            _loggerMock.Setup(x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>())).Verifiable();

            // Act
            bool result = _validator.CheckBitStreamFilterWithOption("testbsf", "testoption");

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning("Bit stream filter: {Name} with option {Option} is not available", "testbsf", "testoption"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
